theme_strategy.tone: Calm, trustworthy, modern clinical coordinator, reassuring for patients and dense/tactical for providers

typography.heading_font: Plus Jakarta Sans Variable, Manrope, sans-serif
typography.mono_font: IBM Plex Mono, JetBrains Mono, monospace

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase

exact_required_copy: Let’s understand your symptoms. I’ll ask a few questions.
Based on your answers, please consult a doctor.
Suitable Facilities for This Care Requirement
Could not reliably extract information from this document.

patient.layout: Mobile-first single column, calm, reassuring, low cognitive load
key_features: Doctor Visit Guidance & Referral status tracking
Instant Emergency SOS Trigger with ambulance simulation

doctor_health_worker.layout: Tablet & Desktop responsive dashboard with progressive disclosure
key_features: Secure Patient Lookup (with QR / Authorization Code)
AI-Assisted Assessment with explicit Doctor Override
Capability-Aware Facility Matching & Structured Referral creation

hospital_doctor_admin.layout: Combined Hospital Operations Queue, dense data table & triage cards
key_features: Accept / Reject / Redirect / Mark Arrived / Update Outcome
Break-glass Patient Summary with auditable event logs

component_patterns.sos_emergency_banner: Instant dark red pulsing header banner with sound/visual cue. Shows 'INCOMING EMERGENCY PATIENT' and triggers immediate ambulance simulation.
component_patterns.symptom_stepper: One-at-a-time question container with progress indicator, smooth entrance animations, and explicit disclaimer banner.
component_patterns.ai_assessment_card: Distinct card with amber/teal badge 'AI-assisted assessment', side-by-side doctor clinical override inputs, and full editability.
component_patterns.ocr_upload_card: Document dropzone showing 'AI extracted — needs verification' pill with side-by-side original image view and editable fields, or 'Could not reliably extract information from this document.' alert state.
component_patterns.referral_timeline: 6-stage horizontal/vertical stepper showing: Created -> Sent -> Received -> Accepted/Rejected/Redirected -> Arrived -> Outcome Updated with audit timestamps.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: All interactive elements and key metric containers MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='sos-button', data-testid='symptom-next-btn').
Never rely on default browser transparent backgrounds in overlays, dropdowns, or floating headers.
Use exact copy strings as specified in requirements for safety disclaimers and status callouts.
Emergency actions (SOS) must bypass long AI loading and immediately show simulated ambulance dispatch and break-glass summary.
Ensure UI files use React 19 / JSX / JS standards as configured in the skeleton project.
